objective: The Traveler and NØVA arrive at the Peskids world — water, children, swimming. NØVA meets Wavo for the first time, uniting the two franchises on-screen for the first time.

metadata.thumbnail_concept: NØVA and Wavo side by side at a glowing pool edge, The Traveler watching from the water's edge

notes: Theme: the first real tenant/client as a whole living world, not just a project.
Emotional conflict: The Traveler realizing this world depends on him getting it right for real children/families, not an abstraction.
Visual motif: water as a recurring symbol-bearing surface (see ../../canon/SYMBOLS.md).
Crossover rule: see ../../canon/WAVO.md — NØVA stays curious-about-everything, Wavo stays the water/swimming specialist.
Real event / fictionalization boundary: see ../../canon/TIMELINE.md row 04.
